description: Snare drum built by modelling a 909-like analogue circuit: a drum tone plus a noise band standing in for the snare wires

params.text: Decay time of the snare wire envelope
Level of the snare wires; at 0% only the drum is heard
Decay time of the snare drum
Click to sound the snare once
How strongly an accent changes the hit

inputs.text: A trigger here sounds the snare
Modulates the decay of the snare wire envelope
A voltage here accents the hit as it is triggered; on some drums that means more level, on others a sharper transient with more harmonics
Modulates the level of the snare wires
Modulates the decay of the drum

notes: there is no sequencer or clock here; the drum sounds once for each trigger patched in, or each click on its button
